realizes.rationale: Publishes id/title and gone only for synthetic missing-task state, with a canonical reference only when a file-bearing document exists; native abandoned tasks do not become synthetic gone.
Builds graph and dependency directions from the addressed master/task population; a missing document supplies no fabricated task state or navigation reference.

This graph adapter carries supplied computed waves and full stored-cycle flags, including Completed members, into the shared graph DTO. Cyclic inProgress members are not placed in the special in-flight state; Completed members remain landed with their cycle annotation. It materializes ready_ids once as a set for graph membership. Cycle identity is derived upstream, not repaired here.
Derives both dependency directions from the declared sibling population and emits id/title, an optional document reference and gone; file-less rows do not acquire an entry reference.

1.note: Named ordinary-master/listed-child reads derive informational dependency fields, explicitly filter newly read dicts by raw task schema before tolerant parsing, and index graph ready membership once. These predicates are not universal body-byte parity or start authority.
